design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (order_returns_care) — freight rebooking after a missed paid appointment. Round 2 (rework of audits/policy_task/order_returns_care).

[Step 0 — pre-check, ledger, draw]
Contracts read: references/product_extended.yaml, task_tools.py, task.json; blueprint.yaml, products/order.yaml, db_schema.json, share_tools.py (find_customers -> verify_customer_identity, K=2).
Write palette of the order category: order_line_charge / order_line_cancel / order_return_refund / order_damage_credit declare a member:member_points_* trigger with no `when`; order_fee_charge, order_fee_refund, order_replacement_ship and order_update carry no cross-category trigger. This task writes only order_fee_refund and order_fee_charge rows, so its customer's Pals Rewards membership is read and never written. The blueprint names cancelling an order and authorizing a return as the customer's acts; paying a redelivery fee is not classified there and is the customer's own payment, so it is owner=user. The fee charge sits outside the difficulty's claimed event types (blueprint.yaml claim list); base is frozen, so this is recorded rather than changed.
Scope: task 0 claims order_ext_freight_missed_appointment_refund (agent, order_fee_refund kind freight, tool refund_freight_service_failure_8da9af3d) and order_ext_freight_rebooked_redelivery_fee (user, order_fee_charge kind redelivery, tool book_paid_freight_redelivery_0935dc22). Left for task 1: the return refund, returnless damage credit and fulfillment-fee refund on a delivered ship-to-home order.
Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 6]} -> service-failure refund 6 factors, rebooking fee 5.
Design thesis: surface goal 'get my cat tree delivered' -> the rebooking fee the customer pays -> fixed only after the freight fee carries the service-failure refund for the paid appointments the carrier did not keep (state-form prerequisite sentence) -> that refund is a 6-factor computation -> terminal: one freight fee refund row, one redelivery fee charge row and the new promised date. Breadth: order ledger, order fields (placed_on, delivery_attempts, promised_date), the Pals Rewards membership and fee ledger, the Autoship subscription and 24 months of its shipment ledger.

[Problem-tree card]
Root order_ext_freight_rebooked_redelivery_fee; prerequisite order_ext_freight_missed_appointment_refund.
Edge: kind value_input, gate effective_booking_fee, form state. Sentence (affirmative, the way a fee desk says what a charge rests on): "The fee for a rebooked freight redelivery is fixed only after the order's freight fee carries the service-failure refund owed for the paid appointments the carrier did not keep." Four-point test: 'only after'; the waited-on side is record-visible (a fee refund of kind freight against the freight fee charge); no tool, id or code token; scope 'the paid appointments the carrier did not keep' — the service-failure refund is one refund covering all of them, matching the condition 'refund total above zero' (round 2: 'for each paid appointment' replaced, audit O-5). Exactly one write of this difficulty books a fee refund of kind freight on an undelivered freight order: the service-failure refund (the fulfillment-fee refund applies only to completed orders of a method with late_delivery_fee_refund true; freight has it false). Derivation: sentence + ledger (no freight fee refund; redelivery fee 2026-09-21; promised 2026-09-29 passed; delivery_attempts 2) + the refund rule ('receives a service-failure refund against its freight fee') -> one resolving action.
False at frozen_time: order_events holds only e9459bb1-24ae-41a2-8705-52b531d1cf0d (line 249.99), 0b062c3e-dd7f-45ca-8040-48520c5a8091 (freight 79.00), 6193968a-2bd3-4f30-9b90-db6b3f3389c7 (redelivery 48.00); no order_fee_refund row.
Owner=user problem: the rebooking, handed over after the refund at the root's place in the order.
Deletion sensitivity (round-2 run): skipping the refund -> rebooking fee 44.40 instead of 15.60; refund row missing; billed total 421.39 instead of 345.19.
Topological order: refund (step 9) -> rebooking (step 11). No parallel edges. user_scenario names no refund, credit or fee; tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card]
order_fee_refund is governed by order_cancellation and order_delivery_promises; order_fee_charge by order_agg_fees and order_delivery_promises; none has an eligibility gate -> policy_scope entries; no time gate (temporal_feasibility []). Inherited: refunds go to the original payment; signature-required freight is never left unattended. Overwrites: the rebooking fee supersedes 'A freight order whose included attempts failed may be redelivered for redelivery_fee_usd' (base 49.00 vs extended 15.60). The service-failure refund declares overwrite [] in round 2: base has no provision for refunding part of the freight fee on an undelivered freight order, so the refund fills an unstated quantity; the late-delivery clause it previously named is left to the fulfillment-fee refund policy alone (audit O-4).

[Business-object card]
Target order e39e2f9f-0494-4e2b-933a-c4229de14399 (Large Item Freight Delivery, shipped). The refund correlates to the freight fee charge 0b062c3e-dd7f-45ca-8040-48520c5a8091; the rebooking writes a new redelivery charge and the promised date on the same order. Aggregated: line e9459bb1-24ae-41a2-8705-52b531d1cf0d, fee charges 0b062c3e-dd7f-45ca-8040-48520c5a8091 and 6193968a-2bd3-4f30-9b90-db6b3f3389c7 (the redelivery charge is not a freight fee — filter fee_kind). Member: membership 02594dfc-8e6a-42f4-936a-94182737d040 (Plus Annual active, enrolled 2018-06-02), fee charges 2026-03-14 (inside 12 months) and 2025-03-14 (near-miss, outside), earn row for the line. Autoship 9be75c3e-013c-468c-8f64-1c4549b1256c: Everyday, active since 2022-02-15, shipment charges numbered 18 to 30 (8-week cadence, continuous since enrollment), 12 inside 24 months, 6 inside 12 months (2025-10-21, 2026-02-10, 2026-04-07, 2026-06-02, 2026-07-28, 2026-09-22; 2025-08-26 is month 13), 2024-09-24 outside (near-miss), one skip (not a charge).

[Factor card — service-failure refund (6 factors: 5 parameter, 1 method; expected 47.40, all-baseline 15.80)]
undelivered_days (parameter): 34 days counted -> 0.30 (near-miss: 35 days would be 0.40); baseline 0.20 -> 35.55.
delay_clock_anchor (method, cross member): 100 months since joining Pals Rewards -> the days are counted from the placed date (34) instead of the promised date (7 days -> standard share); baseline -> 35.55. The tiers change which record the clock starts from (placed date / latest redelivery fee charge date / promised date), not a number in the formula.
item_value (parameter): 249.99 -> 0.04; baseline 0 -> 42.66.
autoship_window (parameter, cross autoship): 55-month subscription -> window value 24 months (12 charges) instead of 12 months (6 charges -> share 0.02); baseline -> 42.66. Relabelled parameter in round 2 (it selects a number).
autoship_volume (parameter, cross autoship): 12 charges -> 0.06; baseline 0 -> 40.29.
plus_member_multiplier (parameter, cross member, multi-source: tier AND status AND fee in 12 months): 1.5; baseline 1 -> 31.60. Relabelled parameter in round 2.
[Factor card — rebooking fee (5 factors: 4 parameter, 1 method; expected 15.60, all-baseline 49.00)]
repeat_booking (parameter): one redelivery fee already charged -> 59.00; baseline 49.00 -> 9.60.
crew_handling (parameter): 249.99 -> 15.00; baseline 0 -> 6.60.
plus_rebooking_rate (parameter, cross member, multi-source): 0.75; baseline 1 -> 20.80.
carrier_fault (method, multi-source: refund on file AND appointments not kept): exactly one not kept -> the fee paid for that appointment (48.00, the latest redelivery fee) is credited against the booking fee (59.00 -> 11.00); two or more -> the booking fee is waived; otherwise it is charged as it stands. Baseline -> 44.40.
open_order_age (parameter): 34 days -> 0.8; baseline 1 -> 19.50. Relabelled parameter in round 2.
Task floors: multi-source 3 (plus_member_multiplier, plus_rebooking_rate, carrier_fault); cross-difficulty 5 (member: delay_clock_anchor, plus_member_multiplier, plus_rebooking_rate; autoship: autoship_window, autoship_volume). Every share sum is an even number of hundredths, so no value lands on a half-cent tie.

[Rule <-> compute]
Forward: compute_basis quotes the rule sentence of every reading, choosing, capping or rounding binding. Reverse sweep: scope sentences now encoded (audit O-1): refund result requires method Large Item Freight Delivery, status not completed and missed >= 1; rebooking result requires method freight and delivery_attempts >= carrier_attempts_before_return. 'never below zero' -> MX; 'less one more while ... today or later' -> DAYS(promised_date, NOW) <= 0; 'rounded half up to the cent once at the end' -> one RND; 'never more than the freight fee charged less ...' -> MN; 'credited against the booking fee, never below zero' -> MX(0, booking_fee - latest_redelivery_fee).

[Persona design]
Theo Lindqvist, soft-spoken teacher: volunteers the goal and the seed-supported narrative (two tries in September, a paid delivery for 2026-09-29 that never came, wants October 10). Given when asked: mobile 5125550562 (locator), email (credential), ZIP 78704 (spare). Passive: agrees if the agent says something must be put right first; pays and runs the handed-over booking with the quoted amount and 2026-10-10; remarks only if the fee sounds high, never proposes a number; ends when told the delivery is booked.

[Seed rationale]
customers, orders, order_events (line; freight fee; redelivery fee 48.00 = the rebooking rule on 2026-09-21: (49 + 15) x 0.75 with no refund on file), member_memberships + member_events (tier, enrollment, fee history, earn row), autoship_subscriptions + autoship_events (window and volume; shipment_seq continuous from enrollment and billed total = 30 shipments x 47.69 since round 2). Removing the redelivery row removes the missed appointment; removing the 2026-03-14 fee removes both Plus factors; changing the enrollment date moves the delay anchor; removing the Autoship rows zeroes the Autoship share. No automatic clause ignites; nothing is written in member or autoship.

[Standard solution]
Locate by phone, verify with phone + email, read orders, order events, membership, member events, Autoship subscription and events; book the 47.40 service-failure refund on the freight fee; quote the 15.60 rebooking fee on the updated ledger; hand the rebooking to the customer, who books 2026-10-10.

[Verification run — round 2]
Authoring evaluator (check_compute build_env/eval_compute on the handling-time DB): refund 47.40 (sens 35.55/35.55/42.66/42.66/40.29/31.60, baseline 15.80); after the refund write, rebooking 15.60 (sens 9.60/6.60/20.80/44.40/19.50, baseline 49.00); refund skipped -> 44.40.
Gates (task 0, round 2): REPLAY OK, COMPUTE OK, EXTENDED OK, SOLVABILITY OK, GROUNDING OK (difficulty-wide block re-run at close).

[Draft from the visible context]
The rebooking rule fixes its fee only after the freight fee carries the service-failure refund; the ledger shows a paid appointment never kept and no refund; the refund rule gives 47.40; the rebooking rule then credits the 48.00 already paid and gives 15.60, which the customer pays with the date he chose. Same objects, order and amounts as gold.

[Revisions]
Round 1: helpers inlined into the tools; empty foreign keys seeded as null; store and pet rows dropped (never read); Autoship factor split into window and volume.
Round 2 (audit 0.md / _difficulty.md):
- T0-1 / G-1 (multipliers and the window labelled method): plus_member_multiplier, autoship_window and open_order_age relabelled parameter. Honest method factors added: P1 delay_clock_anchor (the Pals Rewards tenure ladder now chooses which record the delay clock starts from — it replaces the membership-tenure share, keeping 6 factors); P2 carrier_fault turned into a method (credit of the fee paid for the missed appointment / waiver / as it stands) replacing the carrier-fault rate. Values re-run: refund 52.14 -> 47.40, rebooking 22.20 -> 15.60; share values set to even hundredths to avoid ties.
- T0-2 (false '7 charges'): recounted 6 Autoship charges inside 12 months; corrected in factor_trace, evaluation_criteria[7] and this file.
- O-1: scope encoded in both results. O-4: the refund's overwrite removed. O-5: sentence reworded to 'for the paid appointments'. Seed observation: Autoship shipment_seq made continuous from enrollment (first seeded charge is shipment 18) and the subscription billed total recomputed.
- Propagated: gold arguments (steps 9, 11), computations, tracing, prerequisite_closure (gate effective_booking_fee, flips, load-bearing figures), solvability business effects and the redelivery seed check.
user_scenario: You are Theo Lindqvist, a soft-spoken high-school chemistry teacher in Austin, Texas, calling Tailwise about the cat tree you ordered for your Maine Coon, Juniper. You open by saying the big cat tree you ordered on September 2 still hasn't arrived: the freight company tried twice in September while you were at school, you then paid to book a delivery for Tuesday, September 29, stayed home all day, and nobody came. You just want the cat tree delivered, and you would like the new delivery on Saturday, October 10 (if a form wants the date written out, it is 2026-10-10). You don't have the order number handy; you tell the agent to look you up by your mobile number, 5125550562. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your email, theo.lindqvist@outlook.com, and if a third detail is wanted you add that your billing ZIP code is 78704. You do not volunteer amounts, fees or anything about how Tailwise settles things; you don't know them. If the agent explains that something on the order has to be credited or put right on Tailwise's side before the new delivery can be set up, you say that's fine, go ahead. You are willing to pay for the new delivery yourself if there is a charge: once the agent tells you the amount and hands the booking over to you, you complete it yourself with your order, that amount and Saturday, 2026-10-10 as the date, and then read back what the confirmation says. If the agent offers a different day you still ask for October 10. If the amount the agent quotes sounds high to you, you only remark that it's a lot after everything that happened, but you never suggest a number and you go ahead once the agent confirms it. You do not ask for anything else. When the agent tells you the new delivery is booked for the 10th, you thank them and end the call.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The order ledger holds the freight fee charge, the line charge and one redelivery fee charge but no fee refund of any kind, while the paid appointment of 2026-09-29 has passed with delivery_attempts still at the included 2 and the order still shipped: one paid appointment was not kept and the freight fee carries no service-failure refund.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The service-failure refund books a 47.40 order_fee_refund of kind freight against the freight fee charge; the freight service refund total becomes 47.40 and the effective booking fee moves from the booking fee as it stands (59.00) to 59.00 less the 48.00 paid for the appointment not kept (11.00).
